name: @sleepymug/fleet-net
description: How fleet's ends reach one another over HTTP/2, knowing nothing of boxes or services: sockets that take HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 alike, connections dialed and kept, tunnels a dialer serves over, calls carried through, and calls refused as each protocol has it

scripts.test: node -e "for (const path of ['lib', 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo']) require('node:fs').rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -b && node --test "lib/**/*.test.js"
